```st
FUNCTION_BLOCK FB
VAR_INPUT
    enable   : BOOL;
    values   : ARRAY[1..8] OF INT;
    count    : INT;
    avgEnable: BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    avgOut   : REAL;
END_VAR
VAR
    sumValue  : DINT;
    sampleCount : INT;
    i         : INT;
END_VAR

IF enable AND avgEnable AND (count > 0) THEN
    sampleCount := count;
    IF sampleCount > 8 THEN

    avgOut := DINT_TO_REAL(sumValue) / INT_TO_REAL(sampleCount);
END_IF;
```
